source_message.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],

Thank you for redirecting us to the locked baseline! You were absolutely correct that holding the core foundation completely fixed is the quickest way to review these refinements clearly.

I restored the precise approved foundational assets: the Hero V, the original sweeping second V with its subtly elevated position, and the É accent.

I then placed the refined E and L architecture onto that locked structure:

Narrower, Disciplined Proportions: The letterforms are compressed for a sleek, bespoke luxury aesthetic.

Left-Arm DNA: Every expressive flourish has been removed from the E’s horizontal bars and the L’s foot. They now use flat, crisp, unadorned geometry that expresses the same restraint and structural clarity as the Hero V’s left stem.

I’m excited to secure this direction and meet your Friday schedule! Please tell me whether this balance achieves the exact harmony you had envisioned.

Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],

I've presented the full material terminal exploration using precisely the two-column protocol you requested!

For each option, the left side includes technical reference lines that verify the locked Hero V peak alignment (Line 3), Second V (+2% proportional echo on Line 2), and Cap Height (Line 1), while the right side shows the corresponding identical artwork without those guides.

Throughout every option, the locked Option 2 (Balanced Flow) kerning, Satin Reflection finish, and straight architectural stem geometry remain unchanged. The exploration is limited entirely to the terminal's material character and edge treatment:

Option 1: Soft Architectural (Travertine / Limestone)

A geometric flat shear with gently eased, hand-traveled corners, creating a structural quality that feels quiet and grounded.

Option 2: Sculpted

A fluid, hand-finished transition at the terminal that reads as sculpted instead of mechanically cut.

Option 3: Faceted Gemstone

Subtle precision-cut micro-bevel planes at the tip capture light in the manner of a polished jewel.

Option 4: Cast Bronze

The edge geometry is softened slightly to evoke the rich, natural cooling quality of molded metallurgy.

Option 5: Bespoke Furniture

A deliberately chamfered and broken edge inspired by artisan joinery and master cabinetry.

Option 6: [FREELANCER_NAME_001]’s Interpretation

An architecturally sheared, optically balanced treatment with a delicate linear taper toward the peak, producing an effortless mark of modern luxury.

I'm looking forward to learning which material quality best aligns with the vision for VELLVÉ
